g.title: VitalWatch
g.text: Recorded data → reviewable signal → clinician-led follow-up

g.title: data
g.text: PhysioNet PSV files or validated imports

g.title: replay
g.text: FastAPI reveals observations through the selected hour
Missing values and original observation times stay visible

g.title: model
g.text: LightGBM v1 inference on the backend CPU

g.title: signal
g.text: Save score history; alert on an upward threshold crossing

g.title: dashboard
g.text: Vitals, labs, history, reliability and review checkpoints
Scores support review; they are not diagnoses

g.title: review
g.text: Acknowledge the alert and take ownership
Assess supporting evidence and set review priority

g.title: followup
g.text: Track due / overdue work; explicitly record completion

g.title: handover
g.text: Prepare a template or optional AI draft
Clinician edits, saves and compares revisions

g.title: family
g.text: Assigned patient / family receive a restricted view

g.title: snapshot
g.text: Recent readings, trends, score, alerts and care actions
No future data, outcome labels or display identifiers

g.title: gemini
g.text: API key stays in the backend

g.title: db
g.text: Readings, scores, alerts and care actions

g.title: note
g.text: DEPLOYMENT: FastAPI + replay + LightGBM + SQLite on IBM LinuxONE; Gemini is an external service.
CONTROL: Acknowledgement, follow-up completion and alert resolution are separate clinician actions.
A lower score does not close an alert. If Gemini is unavailable, monitoring and template handovers continue.
